statement: Intake 自动化应把事实整理成可审查 Proposal：建议记录类型、低成熟度状态、provenance、可能重复项和证据强度；真正落成 typed record 需要显式 accept/reject，且自动路径不得越过 observed/candidate。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record OPS.INTAKE.REVIEWABLE_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL; support threshold intentionally exceeds current independent evidence by one group.

review.rationale: Evidence-insufficient Experimental record modeled without promotion; additional independent evidence is required by policy.
